Blend: Blend of Bordeaux varieties; primarily Cabernet Sauvignon from Spring Mountain, Mount Veeder, and Yountville
Tannin Characteristics: Firm and structured with long aging potential
Body Characteristics: Rich and powerful with depth and structure, showing phenolic ripeness and complexity
Finish Characteristics: Lengthy and complex, with integrated savory and mineral tones
Aroma: Black fruit, bay leaf, sage, iodine, and oyster shell
Flavor: Dark berry, savory herbs, minerality, and complexity from oak and terroir
Vinification: Hand-harvested grapes from 43 parcels, fermented in separate lots, malolactic fermentation in French oak (40% new), bottled unfiltered
Maturation: 12 months in French oak (40% new), then 8 additional months after blending
Color: Deep ruby with a purple hue
Vineyard: Spring Mountain, Mount Veeder, and Yountville estate vineyards
Summary: **The Puzzle 2018** is a bold and complex Napa Valley red blend crafted from 43 hillside parcels, including Spring Mountain, Mount Veeder, and Yountville. Aromas of **black fruit, bay leaf, and iodine** lead into a **structured, age-worthy wine** with a long, mineral-laced finish. **Unfiltered and oak-aged**, it’s a stunning expression of the vintage and estate terroir.
Unique Summary: A dynamic red blend from 43 hillside parcels, showcasing Napa's complexity and bottled unfiltered for purity.

Body Characteristics: Lighter-bodied with finely textured chalky elements and focused acidity.
Finish Characteristics: Mineral-rich finish with lingering notes of almond skin, citrus, and pear.
Aroma: Delicate white flowers, coastal minerality, kaffir lime leaf, fresh herbs, and citrus.
Flavor: Fresh fruit, citrus, pear, and almond skin integrated with chalky textures and savory elements.
Vinification: Fermented with 100% native yeast, 80% in 288L French oak barrels and 20% in stainless steel tanks.
Maturation: Aged in 100% French oak barrels (18% new), native malolactic fermentation, bottled June 2023.
Type of cask: French oak (Damy and Billon cooperages), partial stainless steel fermentation.
Color: Pale straw with a luminous, coastal clarity.
Vineyard: Camp Meeting Ridge estate and family-partner vineyards including Wildcat Mountain and Bohan Ranch.
General Recommended Accompanies: Seafood and vegetable-based dishes, especially coastal cuisine.
Stella Recommended: Fiocchi con Peri e Taleggio, Salmon with Prosecco Beurre Blanc, Maiale con Pancetta e Aglio
Summary: Sourced from coastal Sonoma vineyards, this Chardonnay expresses vibrant white flowers, citrus, and herbs with chalky texture and elegant freshness. Barrel-fermented with native yeast and aged in French oak, it showcases the purity and precision of Sonoma Coast terroir.
Unique Summary: A coastal Chardonnay marked by floral aromatics, savory citrus, and elegant chalky texture from native fermentation and precise vineyard sourcing.
Sustainability: Organically farmed estate vineyard and like-minded partner sites

Body Characteristics: Fresh and delicate with elegant balance and a hint of grapefruit zest on the finish.
Finish Characteristics: Refined and zesty with citrus and floral persistence.
Aroma: Floral notes, white peach, and grapefruit peel.
Flavor: Delicate fruit with aromatic freshness and a clean citrus finish.
Vinification: Cold skin maceration before pressing; temperature-controlled vinification; aged on fine lees in vats; fined and filtered before bottling.
Maturation: Aged on fine lees in stainless steel vats.
General Recommended Accompanies: Seafood tapas, grilled fish, lemon-fried squid fritters, prawns al ajillo, tuna empanadas.
Stella Recommended: Insalate Caesae, Petrale Sole Picatta, Pollo alla Calabrese
Summary: Symphonie Rosé 2024 is a Cru Classé organic and vegan rosé from Côtes de Provence, offering floral elegance, white peach, and grapefruit zest in a delicately structured profile. It’s a refined expression of southern French terroir.
Unique Summary: Certified organic and vegan, this Provence rosé blends Grenache, Cinsault, and Rolle into a fresh, harmonious wine with floral lift and citrus-driven finesse.
Sustainability: Certified organic by FR BIO 01 Ecocert

Tannin Characteristics: Polished and firm, adding richness and balance.
Body Characteristics: Creamy and round with fresh acidity and layered texture.
Finish Characteristics: Deep, nuanced, and graceful with lingering spice and dark fruit tones.
Aroma: Black cherry, red currant, black plum, lavender, mint, sage, vanilla, and caramel.
Flavor: Blueberry preserves, dark chocolate, cinnamon, clove, anise, black tea, and chaparral herbs.
Vinification: 2–3 week maceration to extract flavor, color, and tannin, followed by fermentation with traditional methods.
Maturation: Aged 20 months in 100% French oak (38% new) for added complexity and structure.
Vineyard: Primarily Oak Knoll, with Oakville and Stags Leap District sources
General Recommended Accompanies: Herb-roasted pork, mushroom risotto, grilled duck breast, or soft cheeses.
Stella Recommended: Rigatoni al ragu di Maiale, Maiale con Pancetta e Aglio, Scottadito
Summary: This elegant Napa Merlot balances ripe fruit, savory herbs, and spice. With polished tannins and fresh acidity, it's both structured and supple—perfect for food pairing or aging.
Unique Summary: Merlot with finesse—Southern Napa fruit meets French oak aging for depth and grace.

Wine Name: Ken Wright Canary Hill Vineyard Pinot Noir
Tannin Characteristics: Balanced tannins that coat the palate and support a layered finish.
Body Characteristics: Juicy and structured with a fine balance of dark fruit and savory elements.
Finish Characteristics: Complex with bramble, earth, and citrus zest lingering.
Aroma: Juicy blackberry, boysenberry, plum, fresh earth, and orange rind.
Flavor: Blue and black fruits with organic undertones of bramble, earth, and citrus peel.
Vinification: Fermented with native yeasts; minimal intervention to preserve site expression.
Maturation: Aged 10–11 months in French oak barrels (20% new).
General Recommended Accompanies: Duck confit, grilled salmon, mushroom risotto, and pork tenderloin.
Stella Recommended: Salmon Piccata, Maiale con Pancetta e Aglio, Scottadito
Summary: This single-vineyard Pinot Noir from Eola-Amity Hills delivers blue and black fruit, earthy tones, and citrus zest. Organically farmed and aged in French oak, it’s layered, fresh, and built for complexity.
Unique Summary: From volcanic soils and organic farming, Canary Hill Pinot shows purity, structure, and vibrant fruit.
Sustainability: Certified organic; nutrition-based farming focused on vineyard health and terroir expression.
Similar Wines: Ken Wright Willamette Valley Pinot Noir
Goldeneye Duckhorn Anderson Valley Pinot Noir
Langhart & Hill Russian River Valley Pinot Noir

Body Characteristics: Delicate texture with fine vinosity and concentrated aromatics.
Finish Characteristics: Persistent and marked by freshness and minerality.
Aroma: White stone fruits, fresh fruits, floral tones, and subtle biscuit.
Flavor: Apple, crisp pear, citrus, and roasted notes.
Vinification: Low-temperature vinification in stainless steel tanks; traditional method.
Maturation: Aged 50 months on lees; includes over 50% reserve wines.
Color: Straw yellow with fine bubbles and persistent mousse.
Vineyard: Vallée de la Marne, Epernay, Montagne de Reims, Grande Vallée de la Marne
General Recommended Accompanies: Ideal as an aperitif; pairs well with a wide variety of dishes.
Stella Recommended: Insalata Stella with Grilled Prawns, Lobster Escargot, Risotto of the Day
Summary: Billecart-Salmon Brut Réserve is a masterful blend of Meunier, Chardonnay, and Pinot Noir from premier Champagne vineyards. Aged over four years on lees and crafted with precision, it offers a vibrant profile of crisp fruits, floral elegance, and a long mineral finish.
Unique Summary: With 15 vintages blended and over 50% reserve wine, this Champagne delivers exceptional complexity and finesse.

Tannin Characteristics: Fresh and food-friendly with soft grip from Nebbiolo
Body Characteristics: Bright and balanced with cool-fermented purity and acidity
Finish Characteristics: Crisp and refreshing with lingering red fruit tones
Aroma: Expected red berry and floral notes from Barbera and Nebbiolo
Flavor: Vibrant red fruit, cherry, and plum with fresh minerality
Vinification: Fermented and aged in stainless steel at cool temperatures to preserve fruit
Color: Not specified; typically ruby red with purple edges
Vineyard: Hand-harvested grapes from Langhe and Monferrato
General Recommended Accompanies: Pasta, cured meats, light roasts, and pizza
Stella Recommended: Gnocchi di Patate “Nonna Nilla” (Italian sausage and porcini ragu), Rigatoni al Ragu di Maiale, Spezzatino
Summary: **Barbera 'Vezzi' 2022** is a **sustainably farmed blend of Barbera and Nebbiolo** from Langhe and Monferrato, vinified and aged in stainless steel to preserve its **vibrant red fruit, acidity, and clean finish**. A fresh and versatile Piemonte red.
Unique Summary: Keg-exclusive stainless-aged blend highlighting Barbera’s vibrancy and Nebbiolo’s finesse.
Sustainability: Sustainably farmed vineyards in Langhe and Monferrato; no oak, minimal intervention
Similar Wines: Nino Negri Valtellina Superiore Quadrio Nebbiolo

Body Characteristics: Light on its feet yet complex, with melon, stone fruit, and a mineral-driven medium body.
Finish Characteristics: Balanced and persistent with lingering mineral notes.
Aroma: Aromas of stone fruits and melon.
Vinification: Destemmed grapes are left on skins for 12 hours before fermentation in stainless steel to enhance aromatics and clarity.
Maturation: Aged six months on lees in stainless steel.
Color: Light straw with a hint of salmon
Vineyard: Grave and Colli Orientali, planted in gravely and ponca soils
General Recommended Accompanies: Aperitivo, light grilled fish, sashimi, pesce crudo, ceviche
Summary: Scarpetta Pinot Grigio 2024 is a crisp and elegant white from Friuli-Venezia Giulia. Sourced from Grave and Colli Orientali, it combines bright acidity with stone fruit, melon, and a clean mineral edge. Aged six months on lees for added texture.
Unique Summary: From top sites in Friuli’s Grave and Colli Orientali regions, this Pinot Grigio showcases freshness, minerality, and surprising complexity.
Similar Wines: Ken Wright Tyrus Evan Pinot Gris

Body Characteristics: Fresh and crisp with bright acidity and a lightly textured mouthfeel from partial skin contact.
Finish Characteristics: Lingering with notes of sea spray, citrus pith, and salty minerality.
Aroma: Mandarin orange, cherry blossom, wild strawberry, and chalky minerals.
Flavor: Yellow plum, nectarine, citrus, sea spray, and mineral tones.
Vinification: 80% direct-pressed into stainless steel with no skin contact; 20% cold-soaked on skins for added color and structure. Native yeast fermentation, cold-stabilized, and bottled early.
Color: Light peach-pink with clarity and brilliance.
Vineyard: Multiple Rhône-focused vineyards across six sub-AVAs in Paso Robles including Whalerock, Lotierzo, Hollyhock, and Duas Terras.
General Recommended Accompanies: Salmon, sushi, fried chicken, anchovies, sausages, and Mediterranean tapas.
Summary: A Provence-inspired dry rosé from Paso Robles, Patelin de Tablas 2022 features Grenache-driven strawberry and citrus flavors balanced with mineral tension and floral lift. Native fermentation and partial skin contact add texture and depth.
Unique Summary: A Rhône-style Paso Robles rosé blending Grenache, Mourvèdre, and a hint of Vermentino for citrusy lift and complexity.

Body Characteristics: Vivacious and sweet with fresh acidity and smooth, balanced structure.
Finish Characteristics: Pleasantly harmonious and lively with floral and red fruit notes.
Aroma: Delicate violet floral notes with hints of ripe red fruit.
Flavor: Luxuriously sweet with balanced acidity, red berries, and floral freshness.
Vinification: Made from organically farmed vineyards with restricted yields to enhance quality; bottled with persistent bubbles.
Color: Bright ruby red with persistent bubbles.
Vineyard: Estate Quercioli vineyard near Reggio Emilia; organically farmed.
General Recommended Accompanies: An excellent pairing with fruit, dessert and pizza.
Stella Recommended: Baked Garlic Butter Lobster "Escargot Style", Frutti di Bosco
Summary: Quercioli Dolce is a sweet, sparkling Lambrusco from Emilia-Romagna, crafted with organic grapes and certified carbon neutral. It offers vibrant red fruit, floral notes, and a lively, harmonious finish—perfect for fruit desserts or festive pairings.
Unique Summary: A sustainably produced, sweet sparkling red with violet aromatics and juicy red berry character from organically farmed Lambrusco grapes.
Sustainability: Certified sustainable by Equalitas and carbon neutral by Climate Partner

Tannin Characteristics: Lush and round with youthful grip and pleasing softness.
Body Characteristics: Juicy and textured with bold fruit and vibrant intensity.
Finish Characteristics: Fruit-forward and plush with spice and floral echoes.
Aroma: Bright cherry, ripe berries, rose petal, and hints of darker fruits.
Flavor: Juicy cherry, berry compote, floral notes, and soft spice on a lush palate.
Vinification: Young vines (6–25 years) picked and vinified separately from heritage vineyards; native yeast fermentation.
Maturation: Aged 12 months in 80% French oak, 20% American (95% used, 5% new); bottled unfined.
Vineyard: Blend from 27 sites including Hayne, Pesenti, Salvador, Vineyard 101, Fredericks, and Kirschenmann
General Recommended Accompanies: Barbecue, grilled sausages, pizza, or spicy tomato-based dishes.
Stella Recommended: Spaghetti and Meatballs or Bolognese, Penne Arrabbiata, Gambero 'Diavola Style'
Summary: Crafted from young vines across Turley’s famed Zinfandel sites, the 2022 Juvenile bursts with vibrant cherry, berry, and rose petal, delivering a lush, fruit-driven profile with freshness and lift.
Unique Summary: Young-vine Zinfandel from heritage vineyards—plush, energetic, and irresistibly drinkable.

Tannin Characteristics: Velvety with fine texture, softened by oak ageing
Body Characteristics: Amazingly fresh and rich with balanced acidity and a smooth, elegant feel
Finish Characteristics: Silky and persistent with vibrant fruit and soft spice tones
Aroma: Violet, cherry, currant, plum, and spice
Flavor: Fresh red and black fruit with silky acidity and a hint of oak
Vinification: Cold soak to preserve aromas, fermented in stainless steel with délestage maceration over 18 days
Color: Deep ruby red with typical purple hues
General Recommended Accompanies: Pasta, risotto, roasted meats, cheese, and salami
Stella Recommended: Gnocchi di Patate “Nonna Nilla” (Italian sausage and porcini ragu), Rigatoni al Ragu di Maiale, Maiale con Pancetta e Aglio
Summary: **Pajena Barbera d'Alba** by **Enrico Serafino** is a sustainably farmed **Barbera** expressing violet, cherry, and plum aromas with silky acidity and fine texture. Aged 8 months in oak casks, it balances vibrant freshness with elegance, making it a versatile and **impressive red from Piemonte**.
Unique Summary: Grapes are chilled with carbonic snow and gently sorted for maximum aromatic purity, yielding a soft yet expressive Barbera.
Sustainability: Sustainably farmed vineyards; grapes hand-harvested and chilled with carbonic snow to reduce oxidation and sulfur use

Wine Name: Chianti Classico Riserva, Tenuta di Arceno, Toscana
Tannin Characteristics: Soft, round edges with refined structure
Body Characteristics: Savory and elegant with vibrant acidity and fine minerality
Finish Characteristics: Lingering notes of black tea and citrus-toned ripe orange
Aroma: Cedar, cypress, rose, raspberry, and vanilla bean
Flavor: Strawberries, cherry liquor, cacao, coconut, and mineral elegance
Vinification: Hand-harvested Sangiovese and Cabernet; aged 10 months in neutral French oak
Color: Not specified; expected deep ruby typical of Chianti Riserva
Vineyard: Estate in San Gusmè, Castelnuovo Berardenga, Siena, Chianti Classico
General Recommended Accompanies: Red meats, pasta, mushroom sauces, gorgonzola, game, rich risottos
Stella Recommended: Scottadito, Spezzatino, Gnocchi Nonna Nilla with gorgonzola sauce
Summary: **Tenuta di Arceno Chianti Classico Riserva 2019** is a vibrant blend of **Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon**, aged in **neutral oak** to preserve purity and minerality. The palate shines with **strawberries, cherry liquor, cacao, and citrus**, finishing long with notes of **black tea and elegance**.
Unique Summary: A cooler vintage and neutral oak aging highlight minerality and finesse in this structured, expressive Chianti Riserva.
Sustainability: Estate-grown with attention to vineyard expression and environmental harmony

Body Characteristics: Sweet and delicate with modest acidity and good balance.
Finish Characteristics: Hints of fresh apricot on the finish.
Aroma: Intense aromas of ripe yellow fruit (peach, apricot), rose petals, acacia flowers, and ginger.
Flavor: Peach, apricot, ginger, floral tones, with a sweet, delicate palate.
Vinification: Hand-harvested grapes gently pressed and cold decanted; must stored at low temperature. Partial fermentation in autoclave until 5.5% ABV, then fermentation halted. Sterile filtered and bottled to retain freshness and bubbles.
Maturation: No malolactic fermentation; bottled after sterile filtration.
Color: Bright straw-yellow with shimmering hints of gold
Vineyard: Small vineyards in Castiglione Tinella with 40-year-old vines
Summary: Vietti’s Moscato d’Asti DOCG offers a golden sparkle and enticing aromas of peach, apricot, and acacia flowers. Made from 100% Moscato from Castiglione Tinella, it’s delicately sweet with lively bubbles and a refreshing, fruity finish.
Unique Summary: Produced from 40-year-old vines and partially fermented for low alcohol, this aromatic Moscato retains vivid fruit and floral charm in every sip.

Body Characteristics: Fresh and full with harmonious structure and a long mineral finish.
Finish Characteristics: Persistent and mineral-driven with floral and herbal notes lingering.
Aroma: Intense bouquet of exotic fruits, peach, herbs, and wildflowers.
Flavor: Floral and fruity with peach, exotic fruits, herbs, and a vibrant mineral tone.
Vinification: Cold maceration for 12–15 days on skins; fermented in stainless steel tanks at 16–18°C.
Maturation: Aged 4 months sur lie in stainless steel; 2 months in bottle.
Vineyard: Vermentino di Toscana DOC, 9 hectares on medium-texture clay at 50–80 m elevation.
General Recommended Accompanies: Excellent with seafood dishes and antipasti, with lobster and other shellfish.
Stella Recommended: Gamberi All Aglio, Milanese di Pollo, Petrale Sole Piccata
Summary: Plinio honors the legacy of Roman viticulture with a fresh, floral Vermentino from Maremma. A blend of Vermentino and Viognier, it offers exotic fruit and herbal notes with a crisp, mineral finish, aged sur lie for added depth.
Unique Summary: Crafted from Maremma’s clay soils, this Vermentino-Viognier blend delivers floral freshness and mineral length.

Body Characteristics: Well-structured with complexity from lees aging and minerality from Collio’s sandstone and limestone soils.
Finish Characteristics: Clean and vibrant with delicate fruit and mineral persistence.
Aroma: Elegant notes of stone fruit and floral freshness with hints of minerality.
Flavor: Dry and structured with subtle citrus, pear, and mineral-driven clarity.
Vinification: Cold maceration on skins after destemming, fermented with native and cultured yeasts.
Maturation: Aged for 6 months on lees in stainless steel, followed by 2–3 months in bottle.
Vineyard: Hillsides of Collio, 80–250 meters elevation, layers of sandstone, limestone, and clay.
General Recommended Accompanies: Ideal to serve as an aperitif or paired with fish dishes, seafood, and fresh cheeses
Stella Recommended: Petrale Sole Piccata, Milanese di Pollo, Maiale con Pancetta e Aglio
Summary: From the mineral-rich hills of Collio, Marco Felluga’s Mongris Pinot Grigio is a structured and elegant white wine, aged on the lees for texture and complexity. Its freshness and acidity are hallmarks of both the region and the varietal.
Unique Summary: A sustainably farmed Collio Pinot Grigio that combines minerality and elegance, aged six months on lees for refined structure.
Sustainability: Sustainable farming practices with vineyard parcels aged 20–50 years

Body Characteristics: Flavourful and richly vinous with great structure and balance
Finish Characteristics: Richly vinous and persistent with structured tannins
Aroma: Floral hints of rose, violet, and aromatic herbs
Flavor: Floral notes, herbs, vinous red fruit, firm tannins
Vinification: Maceration with délestage and rackings in stainless steel vats at 28°C for about 15 days
Maturation: 10–12 months in 225-liter French oak barrels with 33% rotation; refined in bottle for at least 3 months
Vineyard: Tenuta di Nozzole, Greve in Chianti
General Recommended Accompanies: Beefsteak Florentine style with zolfino white beans in extra virgin olive oil
Stella Recommended: Osso Buco, Lasagna Filetto Bolognese, Filetto, Spezzatino
Summary: **Nozzole Chianti Classico 2021** is a pure **Sangiovese** from the historic Tenuta di Nozzole estate in **Greve in Chianti**. It shows a **bright ruby color**, with aromas of **rose, violet, and herbs**, and a palate driven by **firm tannins** and **balanced structure**. Aged in **French oak**, it reflects the elegance and tradition of **Chianti Classico** winemaking.
Unique Summary: A modern yet elegant Chianti Classico from a historic Tuscan estate, showcasing floral aromatics and firm structure.

Reviews.description: This has intense spice and and floral character, with violets, bell peppers, morello cherries, cloves and tomato leaves on the nose. It’s medium-bodied with sleek tannins. Dense and compact palate. Some walnut notes at the end.
